apple_landing_smoke: const fs=require('fs'); const p='examples/apple-landing/index.html'; const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); const trimmed=s.trim(); if (!trimmed.toLowerCase().startsWith('<!doctype html')) { console.error('html must start with doctype'); process.exit(1); } if (!trimmed.toLowerCase().endsWith('</html>')) { console.error('html must end with </html>'); process.exit(1); } const checks=['<canvas','Apple Nova','@media']; for (const c of checks) { if (!s.toLowerCase().includes(c.toLowerCase())) { console.error('missing '+c); process.exit(1); } } if (s.includes('```')) { console.error('markdown fence found'); process.exit(1); } if (s.length < 5000) { console.error('too short '+s.length); process.exit(1); } console.log('ok '+p+' '+s.length+' bytes');
